interventions.detail: Used a Python 3.10 uv venv instead of system Python 3.12 (old basicsr/facexlib incompatible)
Pinned CPU torch==2.0.1 / torchvision==0.15.2 because basicsr imports torchvision.transforms.functional_tensor (removed in 0.17)
Pinned numpy<2 and opencv-python<4.11 for compatibility with basicsr/facexlib
Installed basicsr etc. with --no-build-isolation since setup.py imports torch; used pip install -e . instead of setup.py develop
Installed libgl1 and libglib2.0-0 for OpenCV
Pre-downloaded GFPGANv1.3 and facexlib/RealESRGAN weights in setup.sh
